source: User-supplied server pathway identity and projected identifier diagnostic screenshot
transcription_whitespace: Indentation and shell prompt spacing normalized; all displayed diagnostic lines preserved.
limits: Both local candidates are different files with different serialized bytes; numerical functional values were not compared, so biological differences or correct abundance/coverage meanings are not established.
Each table has 8838 projected identifier rows, not 8838 established participants; current source index has 8816 rows. Origin, release and sample correspondence remain unverified.
All 8838 rows lack a complete valid visit-key tuple under the delivered validator. The output does not identify which column is null, NaN or a placeholder string.
found=0 and missing=0 reflect that no complete keys entered the comparison, not that none overlap with the source or fixed 3343 people.
source_ambiguous=0 and table_duplicate_rows=0 were computed only over complete valid keys; they do not establish uniqueness when all keys were excluded.
Empty public-code candidate lists mean only no schema names matched the deliberately narrow pathway-code regex; they do not establish no pathways or annotations.
487 numeric nonidentifier fields are a schema count, not 487 verified functional pathways. One additional field besides the four known identifiers and these numeric fields remains uncharacterized.
The registry was inspected for metadata/schema only; no locked-sample row matching or outcome association was done.
No participant values, file pointers, numerical function values, outcomes, P values or model scores were displayed.
